gold_requirements.text: The system shall allow customers to create, log in, and log out of accounts.
The system shall allow customers to store profiles, contact information, and purchase history.
The system shall allow administrators to manage product inventory and categories.
The system shall allow customers to add products to a shopping cart.
The system shall allow customers to confirm orders after checkout.
The system shall provide a search engine for customers to find products.
The system shall provide an API to allow for custom plug-ins.
The system shall send an email confirmation to the customer with order details and tracking number.
The system shall send an email to the System Administrator regarding technical queries.
The system shall use Secure Socket Layer (SSL) for all sensitive communications.
The system shall encrypt all customer data in the database.
The system shall validate credit cards against fraud.
The system shall auto-detect and block IP DOS attacks.
The system shall detect consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall be operational in less than 1 minute after the USB is plugged in.
The system shall support 1000 concurrent logged-in customers.
The system shall retrieve 200 products per second.
The system shall add a product to the shopping cart in less than 2ms.
The system shall search for a product in less than 1 second.
The system shall have an availability of 99.99%.
The system shall allow an optional mirror site for backups.
The system shall provide help bubbles to assist users.
The system shall display error messages that are easy to read.
The system shall operate on an Intel-based system with Slackware Linux 2.6 and Apache Web Server.
The system shall use a SQL-based database for inventory storage.
